unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area (openings deducted)

band.unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area (openings deducted)
band.basis: Sum of distinct components: ACP cassette panel system (QV t1:r9, FR/PVDF/cassette adjusted, cross-checked against fetched Paneltec NZ page) + aluminium subgirt/top-hat (QV t12:r23 + aluminium uplift) + thermally-broken brackets + EPDM joint baffle + 266 lm of 3mm folded aluminium flashings (QV t21 rows +3mm uplift) + 6-week 14m diesel boom (QV t8:r15) + sundry allowances. Total for 450 m2: low $290,250, high $413,100, midpoint $351,900. Allowances carry only ~6-9% of the total. GST-exclusive, no prelims/margin/design (excluded by scope). Confidence low because (a) QV system-rate inclusions are unstated, (b) flashing thickness uplift is judgement, and (c) the QV rows are unreviewed.

Sum of cited QV components: ACP cassette system 480-700 + aluminium subgirts/thermal-break brackets 115-155 + 3mm folded PVDF flashings 50-65 + 6-week diesel boom lift 16-22 + sundries allowance 18-32. Total for 450 m2 = $306,000-$436,500 (low 680 x 450 = 306,000; high 970 x 450 = 436,500). Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent fees, rigid air barrier, fire stopping, scaffold/edge protection, and PS1/PS3. Low confidence: wide QV Reynobond range (458-920) and proxy adjustments for subgirts and flashings; allowances carry only about 3% of the total. Centre is Auckland (AKL QV rates, the highest of the three centres).

band.unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area (450 m2, openings deducted)
band.basis: Sum of cited QV rows plus stated gauge/proxy adjustments plus four minor allowances. Panel system $421-458/m2 (QV Alupanel straight, corroborated by Paneltec NZ $400-450/m2 supply/fabricate/install); subgirt top-hats $87-104/m2 (QV ExoTec top-hat proxy, +20% for aluminium); thermally broken brackets $8-16/m2 (allowance); 266 lm of 3mm PVDF flashings $118-151/m2 (QV 0.95mm straight-flashing row x1.75-2.25); 6-week 15m diesel boom lift $18-20/m2 (QV day rate x30 days + delivery); openings $5-10, drawings/numbering $9-18, clean/waste $4-9 (allowances). Allowances are ~5% of the total. GST exclusive; excludes preliminaries, margin, design, consent, and all items listed as excluded. Total for 450 m2 = $301,500 (low) to $353,700 (high). Main uncertainty: whether the QV ACP row already includes the subgirt/carrier - if so, deduct ~$87-104/m2. QV rows are unreviewed.
